activity.notes: Seleucus I founded the Seleucid Empire after recovering Babylonia and took the royal title in 305 BCE. ATLAS records the royal phase 305–281, excluding his earlier satrapal and strategos authority.

sources.title: Seleucus I Nicator - Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford Classical Dictionary identifies Seleucus I as founder of the Seleucid empire and states that he took the title of king in 305 BCE.

sources.title: Time Line and King Lists - The Making of a King
sources.citation_text: Oxford's Hellenistic king list gives Seleucus I Nicator as ruler from 305 to 281 BCE.
